title: Snap Fitness vs Jetts NZ — 24/7 Budget Gym Comparison 2026
meta_desc: Compare Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ prices, locations, and equipment for 24/7 budget gym membership
intro: With over 50 locations across New Zealand, Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ are two of the most popular 24/7 budget gym chains. Both offer affordable membership options, but which one provides the best value? In this article, we'll compare their prices, locations, and equipment to help you make an informed decision.

sections.heading: Membership Prices
sections.body: When it comes to membership prices, both Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ offer competitive rates. However, there are some differences in their pricing structures.

sections.heading: Locations
sections.body: Both Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ have multiple locations across New Zealand. Snap Fitness has over 30 locations, including Auckland, Wellington, and Christchurch, while Jetts NZ has over 20 locations, including Auckland, Wellington, and Queenstown.

sections.heading: Equipment and Facilities
sections.body: Both gyms offer a range of equipment and facilities, including cardio machines, free weights, and group fitness classes. However, Jetts NZ is known for its state-of-the-art equipment and modern facilities.

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: Ultimately, the decision between Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ comes down to your individual needs and preferences. If you're looking for a no-contract option with affordable prices, Jetts NZ may be the better choice. However, if you're willing to commit to a 12-month contract, Snap Fitness may offer better value.
